options.description: Draw the bullets with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says of `env` and `platform`.
options.name: ascii

options.description: The marker for each item. One value is used at every depth; an array is read by depth and cycles, so `['arabic', 'alpha', 'roman']` is the outline of a legal document and `['bullet', 'dash']` is the default.
options.name: enumerator

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: How far the whole block is indented. Defaults to 0.
options.name: indent

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

options.description: The number the first item of a counting list has. Defaults to 1. Only the counting styles read it, and a function is told `index` from 0 regardless.
options.name: start

options.description: The widest the block may be. Defaults to `terminalWidth()`.
options.name: width

api.signature: function outline(items: readonly OutlineItem[], opts?: OutlineOptions): string
